thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — planning a short pin + minor runtime config change for EU (eu-west) to lock model v3.2.1 -> v3.2.1-quant at 2026-05-16 02:00 UTC (30m window). Will post statuspage and a customer blurb.

samir: timeline? deps? any forced restarts?

elaine: timeline: start 1769508000-ish (02:00 UTC), expected finished by 02:30. No full infra restarts; rolling pin on Dedicated pools. We'll drain new requests to canary nodes first.

marco: what's the exact deploybot command so ops can trigger if needed?

deploybot: @channel deploy job created
```
/deploy pin --pool=dedicated-eu-west --model=v3.2.1-quant --strategy=rolling --batch-size=8
```

marco: thx. can we auto-fallback if error budget breached?

elaine: yes — automatic fallback -> v3.2.1 (non-quant) if error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increases > 180ms over baseline. Manual rollback if >2% errors or customer-impacting anomalies.

support_lead: I'll prep statuspage + customer email snippet. Draft below — please quick review:

```
Status: Maintenance - rolling model pin in eu-west
Scheduled: 2026-05-16 02:00 UTC for ~30 minutes
Impact: Briefly reduced throughput for some Dedicated pools; API responses may fall back to warm model variants. No auth or data loss expected.
What we're doing: pinning runtime to a quantized model variant to reduce token cost and improve tail latency. We'll monitor and rollback if any regressions.
If you rely on strict model versions, please contact support@redwood.ai and we'll coordinate.
```

nina: LGTM. Add note about ETA for statuspage updates (start + done). Also add a line for 'how to reach us' with on-call link.

support_lead: added. I'll publish prestart at T-15m and post at completion. Template for statuspage update payload (ops can paste into our status tool):

```
{
  "component": "Inference API - eu-west",
  "status": "maintenance",
  "body": "Rolling model pin to v3.2.1-quant starting 02:00 UTC for ~30m. Expect brief degraded throughput; no data loss.",
  "start_time": "2026-05-16T02:00:00Z"
}
```

samir: ops checklist before start?

marco: quick checklist:
- ensure canary pool health green
- ensure backups of KV cache snapshot
- prewarm fallback model on alternate nodes
- monitoring alarms set: error-rate, p95 latency, GPU OOMs
- slack-alert channel: #eng-oncall

elaine: ownership:
- support -> publish statuspage/email
- ops -> run deploybot + monitor
- eng-pltfm -> standby to unpin and cutover if needed

marco: if we see degraded outputs (quality regressions), decision is immediate unpin + revert traffic to v3.2.1 (non-quant), escalate to eng-pltfm. Who will execute unpin?

samir: I'll execute rollback command and notify support. Rollback command:
```
/deploy unpin --pool=dedicated-eu-west --model=v3.2.1-quant
/deploy deploy --pool=dedicated-eu-west --model=v3.2.1 --strategy=fast
```

deploybot: Noted — can be run with `--confirm` by an authorized user. Audit log will capture actor.

support_lead: I'll draft the customer follow-up template for any rollback case. Will post in #support when ready.

elaine: perfect. please react with :thumbsup: when you've posted the prestart and assigned on-call.

nina: prestart scheduled + pinged @eng-oncall 15m before.

marco: canary green, KV snapshot taken.

samir: rolling now (starting canary). will post updates here.

deploybot: Deploy job `pin-1769504321` started on pool=dedicated-eu-west. Progress: canary(1/3) -> 0.04% error rate.

samir: canary passed. moving to next batch.

elaine: posting statuspage 'maintenance started' now.

support_lead: published prestart. customers notified.

deploybot: Deploy job `pin-1769504321` completed. All nodes: 0.02% avg error rate. No rollback triggered.

marco: verified post-deploy health. p95 latency within baseline.

support_lead: published 'maintenance completed' on statuspage and sent completion email. closing out thread.

nina: thanks team :tada:
